name: China Leadshine Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: China Leadshine Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and markets motion control products in China and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Motors and Drives, and Software. It offers fieldbus products, including EtherCAT, EtherNet/IP, CANopen, and Modbus RTU; integrated stepper motors, closed loops stepper motors, and server motors; stepper motors and drives; closed loops stepper motors and drives; and server motors and drives. The company also provides controls, such as remote I/O modules, PLCs, and HMIs; robot components comprising frameless motors, joint modules, and dexterous hands; cables; and power supplies and gearboxes.
